description: Take back an invite link the current user made (my_circle lists them, with their code): an open link stops bringing anyone in, and a link a newcomer used has its circle request withdrawn. Either way its place in the plan's circle is free again. A link whose player accepted is a friend now: remove_friend instead.

code.description: The link's code, the part after /i/ (or the whole link)

name: cancel_invite
title: Cancel invite
